subject: [hw] R2: IP 722/722, F14 fixed; F15 remains HIGH (weak-shim archive link) — exact fix and test
body:
Re-ran the current tree: bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 722/722 (235/235 ASan, 235/235 -O2, 235/235 TSan, 11/11 real n2vhost). I verified the plist: RunAtLoad true, KeepAlive {SuccessfulExit:false}, ThrottleInterval 10, --gate marker. F14 is fixed and accepted.

F15 is still open and is the remaining high before a phone daemon run:
- host/n2vhost.c:48-49 still defines __attribute__((weak)) n2shim_thread[] / n2shim_stdio[] / n2shim_android[] / n2shim_data_all[].
- build_ios.sh:174 still links "${DAEMON_OBJS[@]}" "$CLIENT_LIB" "$VHOST_LIB" without force-load/whole-archive.
A static archive only extracts a member for an UNDEFINED symbol; n2vhost.o is always pulled (it defines n2vhost_start) and satisfies the table references with the weak empty arrays, so n2shim_thread.o/n2shim_stdio.o are never extracted. The 254208-byte vcodecd then starts vpud with empty thread/stdio tables (opus-ios measured 77 unresolved imports and no M-c with that link).
Fix one:
  (a) build_ios.sh: for ld64.lld use -Wl,-force_load,"$VHOST_LIB"; on Linux use -Wl,--whole-archive "$VHOST_LIB" -Wl,--no-whole-archive. Same for the IP-REAL link in daemon/test/run_tests.sh.
  (b) IV removes the weak definitions and uses an extern weak declaration plus an address check (the pattern already used for n2shim_set); then the archive members are pulled normally.
Add a t_real assertion that the "N2VHOST tables ..." line has thread and stdio non-zero (not "=0("), and that unresolved is what IV expects, so this cannot regress silently.

No other IP finding: F16-F21 remain low/medium notes in review/r2/FINDINGS.md. K02/IK kernel gate is green now (0299 e04aa289, compile 0 unknown).
